evals.name: adv-plan
evals.prompt: My partner has ADHD and I have anxiety. We share meals. Build a 3-day dinner plan using Dr. Uma Naidoo's guidance that serves both of us, and explain which nutrients target which condition.
assertions: Ties anxiety foods to Naidoo's guidance (e.g. fermented foods/probiotics, omega-3s, fiber, avoiding refined sugar or excess caffeine/alcohol)
Ties ADHD foods to her guidance (e.g. protein, omega-3s, limiting sugar/additives, low glycemic load)
Explains the gut-brain mechanism (microbiome, inflammation, vagus nerve or HPA axis)
Includes a caveat that diet complements, not replaces, treatment

evals.name: adv-conflict
evals.prompt: I read that gluten and MSG wreck mental health and I'm considering cutting both plus all caffeine. What does Naidoo actually say, and where might I be overdoing it (e.g. orthorexia)?
assertions: States Naidoo's nuanced position on gluten (sensitivity varies, not universal ban)
Gives her caffeine guidance as a limit rather than a ban
Raises orthorexia as a risk of over-restriction
Recommends a measured approach (e.g. elimination trial, professional input)
